mari: heads up — hitting a weird edge with JSON mode + tool calls. Node SDK (v1.1.0) returns a function call with args as a JSON string, but the python SDK (v1.2.3) is giving a parsed object. When the model omits optional keys, our validator rejects it downstream (schema expects explicit nulls).

jasper: can you paste a minimal example? is this during streaming or non-streaming?

mari: non-streaming. Minimal payload from Node: ```json
{ 
  "name": "validate_user",
  "arguments": "{\"email\":\"x@example.com\"}"
}
```
Python gives: ```json
{
  "name": "validate_user",
  "arguments": { "email": "x@example.com" }
}
```

sophia: oh that mismatch will break our schema validator for sure if it expects an object. Looks like node SDK is leaving args as raw JSON string for function calls (string vs object parity bug).

alex: @mari @jasper this smells like the Node SDK's JSON mode handling for tool calls — we had a known regression where parseJson was behind a feature flag. Can you confirm Node request included `json_mode: true` or `response_format: json`?

mari: yep, `response_format: json` in the request. Also observed that when the model omits optional `phone` field, our validator (ajv) fails because schema used `required: ["email", "phone"]` in some onboarding prompts.

jasper: two separate issues: (1) SDK parity (string vs parsed object), (2) schema over-specifying required optional fields. Quick fix: update schema to not require optional keys and coerce types. Longer fix: SDK helper should normalize function call args to always be object if valid JSON.

ci-bot: build #3312 failed — tests/sdk-parity/node-jsonmode-toolcalls.ts:45 — assertion error (expected object, got string)

mari: thanks CI, exact failure. This is blocking the sample-app on the quickstart because our example expects parsed args. New users hit onboarding friction when copy-pasting the Node example and hitting schema errors.

sophia: proposed plan: (a) patch Node SDK to parse `arguments` if it's a JSON string and expose a `normalizeToolCall` helper, (b) add a doc note in quickstart about schema optional fields + example schemas, (c) add an SDK lint rule to warn about `required` misuse in sample schemas.

alex: +1. We should also add an opt-in strict mode that preserves raw types for power users. Default to normalized for DX.

jasper: for the patch I can do a small PR: detect if `typeof arguments === 'string'` then `try { args = JSON.parse(arguments) } catch { /* leave as-is and attach parse_error metadata */ }` — also add unit + e2e test that simulates model returning stringified JSON.

mari: that would unblock onboarding. Can we also make server-side verifier tolerant? e.g., ajv with `removeAdditional: true` and `coerceTypes: true` so new users don't get cryptic errors.

alex: yes but be careful — we don't want to silently accept malformed input for Dedicated / Private where customers expect strict validation. Maybe a config flag per deployment: `allow_schema_coercion: true|false` default true for Hosted quickstart.

sophia: I'll add an entry in the docs / quickstart about `Hosted defaults to permissive schema checks; Dedicated can opt-in to strict validation` — link in PR.

mari: filing ticket for SDK parity + docs: https://tickets.redwood.ai/RI-2345 — assigned to jasper. @jasper can you include a minimal reproducer in the ticket and mark as high priority for quickstart?

jasper: yep will send PR + ticket later today. Will add a unit test using the model-stub that returns stringified args.

mari: tiny UX ask — can we add a small SDK helper `parse_tool_args_safe()` that returns `[args, parseError]` so sample apps can show best practice?

alex: good idea. Make it part of the stable helpers in both Node & Python. Also update the sample-app to call it, show fallback logic.

sophia: assigning follow-ups: jasper -> SDK patch & tests, mari -> update sample-app quickstart code snippet, me (sophia) -> docs change + retention note for Dedicated. I'll create a GH project board card.

ci-bot: ticket RI-2345 created and linked to project 'devex-onboarding'

mari: thanks all :tada: small change but big DX win.

alex: once PRs merged we'll add a short release note in the changelog and update the SDK migration guide.

jasper: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/487 (includes tests). Please review.

mari: reviewed and left a tiny comment re: parseError shape.

jasper: comment addressed, tests green locally. Will wait for CI re-run.

ci-bot: build #3313 queued for PR 487

sophia: moving this to DONE when CI passes and docs merged. Thanks!
